enchantment.jem_world_boss_tiers.progres: Applied only from a book through an anvil. Evolves compatible vanilla and modded weapons, tools, and armor through World Tier III. Equipment keeps normal durability, Mending, and Unbreaking, but cannot be lost to fire, despawn, or the void. Tier III to IV and IV to V add no further power.
tooltip.jem_world_boss_tiers.progression: Progression I: ready to evolve. Normal durability; protected from accidental loss.
Progression II: +5%% damage, +1 damage, +0.25 attack speed, faster use, arrow piercing II.
Progression III: +10%% damage, +2 damage, +0.40 attack speed, 15%% crit, arrow piercing III.
Progression I: armor is ready to evolve. Normal durability; protected from accidental loss.
Progression II: +5%% armor stats. Helmet resists projectiles; chest resists heavy hits; leggings grant Speed; boots resist falls and knockback.
Progression III: +10%% armor stats. Projectile reflection, timed guard, Speed II and attack speed, stronger fall and knockback protection.
